fresh_context_evidence.inputs: Neutral reader contract, current assignment, frozen authored snapshots, pinned executed preview, and referenced current teaching figures.
fresh_context_evidence.manual_estimation: Each positive-integer interval and concrete individual reason was authored after personally reading its full assigned body, code and actual saved output; no word/line-count formula, old-minute inheritance or wall-clock conversion.

method.audience: Mathematically prepared highschool or basic-university reader new to these topics.
method.included: Read body, view diagrams, understand example code and actual outputs, and briefly pause to think.
method.excluded: Installation/download, executing or modifying exercises, waiting for training, extra prerequisite reading, and duplicate generated navigation/index material.
method.read_order: Canonical assignment order. The first four complete snapshots were read in a batch and then their actual outputs in the same order; later batches displayed each full snapshot immediately followed by its actual output. Each unique figure was personally viewed when its first assigned page was reached.
method.own_execution: No lesson/example/exercise, model training, GPU, model download or data download was run. Browser extraction read existing executed-preview outputs only.
method.browser: Playwright Chromium /usr/bin/chromium --no-sandbox, article.md-content__inner and div.output extraction.
method.figure_views: All seven referenced SVGs rendered with installed Inkscape and then actually viewed using view_image. Exact render commands, source/render hashes, return codes and stderr are preserved.
